_evidence: 0x004087aa: ebp = max(X + addend, [0x0062a0a0]) (cmp/jge signed) is the idiv divisor of sx([0x0060138c]) << 14 (cdq; shld/shl 14). [0x62a0a0] is the positive divisor floor (a zero or negative floor lets ebp be 0 or tiny and the original #DEs or overflows, which the game never does), varied 0x100..0x4000; the dividend dword is varied -2^24..2^24, so |quotient| <= 2^38/2^8 = 2^30 fits and both clamps (0x7000 high, 0x2000 low) and the unclamped middle are reached. 0x00602b4c (imul/shrd multiplier), 0x00601388 and 0x0062eca8 (addends) are plain i32: any value is valid.
